description: Header file defining structures, functors, and functions for multi-tensor GPU operations using Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) in PyTorch's MPS backend, including tensor chunking, pipeline state management, and multi-tensor apply functions.

classes.name: FusedAdamEncodingFunctor
classes.description: Functor for encoding fused Adam optimizer parameters into Metal compute encoder.

classes.name: FusedSgdEncodingFunctor<true>
classes.description: Specialization of functor for encoding SGD with momentum.

classes.name: FusedSgdEncodingFunctor<false>
classes.description: Specialization of functor for encoding SGD without momentum.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Encodes optimizer parameters into Metal compute encoder for fused Adam or SGD.

methods.name: getFusedAdamCPLState
methods.description: Retrieves Metal pipeline state and function for fused Adam optimizer kernel.

methods.name: getAmpCPLState
methods.description: Retrieves Metal pipeline state and function for fused optimizer kernel.

methods.name: multi_tensor_apply_for_fused_optimizer
methods.description: Applies a fused optimizer kernel to multiple tensors with chunking and batching.

methods.name: multi_tensor_apply
methods.description: Applies a generic multi-tensor kernel to multiple tensors with chunking and batching.
